source_text: 立春（Start of Spring）在中国农历中表示春天的开始。立春之⌊，白天变得更长，天气 也愈发温暖；万物开始复苏，大地充满生机。人们常说“一年之计在于春”，农民在这个 时节开始播种，为全年的丰收打下基础。中国人早在三千年前就已开始在立春这一天举 行庆祝活动。数百年来，迎春一直是民间的重要习俗。在春暖花开的日子里，人们常常 外出游玩，欣赏春天的美景。
reference_translation: Start of Spring marks the beginning of spring in the Chinese lunar calendar. On this day, the days become longer and the weather gets warmer. All things start to revive, and the earth is full of vitality. People often say, "The whole year's work depends on a good start in spring." Farmers begin to sow seeds at this time, laying the foundation for a bountiful harvest throughout the year. The Chinese have been holding celebrations on the day of Start of Spring since three thousand years ago. Welcoming spring has been an important folk custom for hundreds of years. On warm and sunny spring days, people often go out to enjoy the beautiful scenery of spring.
